{{Top|leg}}
'''Jump point 125:35:90''' was a designated [[Hyperspace jump point/Legends|jumpzone]] within the [[Essesia system]] in the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]]. [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Coh Veshiv]]'s [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Empire Forever]]'', was due to arrive in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] at that jumpzone, transit the system on an inspection tour, then leave via [[jump point 180:45:115]].<ref name="CCV">{{WEGCite|book=The Far Orbit Project|story=The Capture of Coh Veshiv}}</ref>
